حِذْرِيَةٌ A rugged piece of ground: (S, K:) or the top of a mountain, when it is hard and rugged, but level: (Aboo-Kheyreh:) and rough ground: (TA:) and a rugged [hill such as is termed] أَكَمَة; as also ↓ حِذْرِيَآءُ : (K:) pl. حَذَارَى and حَذَارٍ. (S.) ＝
-A2- Also The عِفْرِيَة [or feathers of the back of the neck] of a cock: (S, K:) pl. as above. (K)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
